needed.evidence: No continuous sidewalk; people and goods occupy the road edge
needed.suggestion: Construct a 1.5 m paved footway on the left, relocating the roadside stalls to a designated market zone.

needed.evidence: Stalls, parked vehicles and goods block the usable path
needed.suggestion: Enforce a no-parking, no-stall zone along the left kerb to keep the footway clear.

needed.evidence: Uneven, debris-strewn surface at the road edge
needed.suggestion: Resurface the left edge with a smooth, level pavement to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Broken paving and litter on the right sidewalk
needed.suggestion: Repair the right sidewalk with a continuous, level surface and add a litter bin.

needed.evidence: High pedestrian activity and shops on both sides with no marked crossing
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with dropped kerbs at the busiest point.

needed.evidence: No street lights visible along the urban street
needed.suggestion: Install LED street lights at 30 m intervals along both sides of the road.
